ALASKA MEDICAID
Ergocalciferol Oral Drops
Oral Solution: 8000 units/mL, 60mL
Preferred Medication:
Drisdol®
Non-Preferred Medication:
Calciferol®
INDICATION:
Ergocalciferol is a dietary supplement’. As a dietary supplement under the Dietary Supplement
Health and Education Act (DSHEA) of 1994 this product cannot be labeled to “...to
diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.””
CRITERIA FOR APPROVAL:
1. The patient has a diagnosis of Rickets’.
Length of Authorization:
1. Coverage may be approved for up to 1 year.
REFERENCES / FOOTNOTES:
'Ergocalciferol monograph, Clinical Pharmacology. Accessed 06/04/2009.
* Dietary Supplement Health And Education Act of 1994, available at
<http://web.health.gov/dietsupp/ch1.htm> Accessed 06/04/2009.
